title: pause -> pauseWithdraw -> unpause OVER-MINTS phUSD: stale phUSDPerSecond (sized for pre-pause totalStaked) accrues over the shrunken stake on unpause
description: phUSDPerSecond is sized for totalStaked at the last stake/withdraw (= S0, set from the pre-pause stake). When the contract is paused and one or more users pauseWithdraw, totalStaked drops to S1 < S0, but pauseWithdraw does NOT call _updatePhUSDEmissionRate (L245-261), so phUSDPerSecond stays sized for S0. On unpause, _updatePool accrues phUSDReward = timeElapsed * phUSDPerSecond and divides by the smaller S1 (L420-422), inflating accPhUSDPerShare by factor S0/S1. claim() does NOT recompute the emission rate, so the stale over-rate persists until the next stake/withdraw; remaining stakers are minted S0/S1 x their intended phUSD.
impact: Uncapped phUSD supply inflation: remaining stakers are minted phUSD at an over-rate of S0/S1 for the entire window between unpause and the next rate-recomputing stake/withdraw. The over-minted phUSD is value created from nothing, diluting all phUSD holders and breaking the APY invariant (story-006 / INV-7). No principal theft. Under the LIVE zero-APY config (KI-10) the phUSD stream is immunized, which is why this is held at Medium; a shipped non-zero-APY config with a long stale window and large S0/S1 would make the inflation effectively unbounded (re-classify High).
attackPath: 1. desiredAPYBps > 0, so phUSDPerSecond is non-zero (set on last stake/withdraw from pre-pause totalStaked = S0).
2. Contract is paused; one or more users pauseWithdraw, dropping totalStaked to S1 < S0. pauseWithdraw does NOT call _updatePhUSDEmissionRate (L245-261), so phUSDPerSecond stays sized for S0.
3. Contract is unpaused. _updatePool accrues phUSDReward = timeElapsed * phUSDPerSecond and divides by the smaller S1 (L420-422) -> accPhUSDPerShare inflated by factor S0/S1.
4. claim() does NOT recompute the emission rate, so the stale over-rate persists until the next stake/withdraw; remaining stakers claim S0/S1 x intended phUSD.
recommendation: Recompute the phUSD emission rate inside pauseWithdraw (call _updatePhUSDEmissionRate after totalStaked changes), or force a recompute on unpause before any accrual, so phUSDPerSecond always matches the live totalStaked. Safe-config guidance for the (zero-APY) live deployment: do not enable a non-zero desiredAPYBps without this fix.

tier3Verification.detail: Tier-3 CONFIRMED: overMintFactor == S0/S1. Distinct from M-01 (claim revert), L-06 (exiting user forfeits OWN accrual), L-13 (emission floors to ZERO = under-emission, the opposite), C-03 (owner-set high APY). Genuinely new this run.

footgunNote: Law-3 footgun: a non-malicious operator enabling APY would be surprised that a pauseWithdraw during pause inflates phUSD on unpause. NOT suppressed under KI-4 (forfeiture does not cover over-minting to OTHER stakers) or KI-10 (zero-APY only lowers likelihood).
borderlineFlag: BORDERLINE Medium-vs-High-if-APY>0: live zero-APY -> Medium; a shipped non-zero-APY config with a long stale window -> re-classify as High (uncapped inflation).
